desc: pixel sort — one tonal range smears into long runs

params.name: range
params.help: which tones get sorted, dark -> bright

params.name: pull
params.help: how far a run drags its colour sideways

params.name: width
params.help: how much of the picture qualifies to streak

params.name: dir
params.help: streak direction: vertical <-> sideways (0.5) <-> the other way
